entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please hold for the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. My name is Alex, agent ID 302. How can I help you today?
I need to return an item.
I can certainly look into that for you. Can I start with your full name and order number?
Sarah Jenkins. Order number is VF78901.

Thank you, Sarah. I'm pulling up your order now... I see the ClubFit Jersey, delivered on November 22nd. To make sure I'm handling this correctly, could you tell me what specifically is the issue with the jersey?
Okay, so it's a preference issue, not a defect like a tear or a faulty zipper, correct?
It's just too tight. That's all.
I understand. Let me just confirm the return eligibility for you. One moment.

Alright, thank you for waiting. I see here that your item was delivered 50 days ago. According to our policy for standard apparel, you have 90 days to make a return. So, you're well within the window.
Great. So I wasn't wasting my time calling.
Not at all. We can definitely get this sorted out. Would you like to process an exchange for a different size, or would you prefer a refund?
I guess an exchange is fine, if you have it.

We do. I can set that up for you right now. I'll email you a prepaid shipping label. Just send the original jersey back to us, and once it's scanned by the carrier, we'll ship out the new size to you.
Fine. Whatever. Just send the email.
The email is on its way. You should receive it within the next 5 minutes. Is there anything else I can assist you with today, Sarah?
Alright. Well, thank you for calling VeloFit, and have a good rest of your day.
